caption: Commercial & Industrial Loans (C&I Loans) year-over-year growth (vermillion, left axis) against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1993–2026. Loan growth turns AFTER the market: in May 2020 loans spiked to ~+30% YoY (firms drawing credit lines) even as equities crashed. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
